args: {"code":"const files=await glob({pattern:'data/orders/*'}); const contents=await Promise.all(files.files.map(path=>read({path}))); const totals={}; for(const f of contents){const d=JSON.parse(f.content); if(d.status==='paid') totals[d.customer]=(totals[d.customer]||0)+d.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty*i.unitPriceCents,0)} return Object.entries(totals).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);"}
